scenario: An independent recruiter enters from the public Web surface, inspects the browser-only Demo, signs into an isolated local production build, attaches governed sources, reviews speaker and forwarded-source boundaries, resolves or durably defers identity, corrects a wrong-person source, separates current state from history, handles conflict and supersession, invalidates stale approval, observes verified and unknown local effects, reconciles before retry, revokes and restores source authority, survives a timeout-after-commit without duplicates, reads Wiki and People, reloads durable state, records no-action, and deletes governed lineage. Responsive behavior is compared with the currently deployed site.
frozen_evidence: pnpm check: docs and architecture checks, lint, Web typecheck, Web 178 passed / 1 skipped, Backend 106 passed, backend CI, and final production Web build passed

review_plan.reason: The requested standard is an end-to-end recruiter click outcome and paid readiness.
The tested loop governs candidate evidence, identity, temporal state, action authority, external-effect truth, and deletion.
The requested standard explicitly includes the whole Web click experience across responsive surfaces.
The artifact does not score, rank, compare, or assess candidate quality, traits, fit, or hiring outcomes.
No candidate-facing communication or autonomous candidate contact is executed.

reviews.top_finding: The frozen local workflow is coherent, recoverable, and duplicate-safe across the tested synthetic loop, but production entry, real cross-day continuity, and paid field value remain unproven.
Local evidence and identity boundaries now cover almost the whole matrix; the deployed Demo still turns unresolved relative time into confirmable action authority.
vetoes: The deployed public Demo still converts unresolved relative time into confirmable deadline and meeting authority.

reviews.top_finding: Responsive Web passes the directly observed viewport matrix, while real keyboard, VoiceOver, background/relaunch, and physical-device evidence are missing.

score.meaning: Direct frozen-build atomic evidence count; specialist rubric scores are reported separately and are not averaged.

agreements: The frozen local Web candidate is highly usable for the directly tested governed relationship workflow and is materially stronger than the 64-point baseline.
The improvement from 85 to 94 is earned by nine newly passed current-build atoms; no historical-only evidence is scored.
Capture recovery, identity boundaries, correction history, stale approval, source withdrawal, and restore-to-review are now directly proven.
The system is not ready to charge for while production is inaccessible, the live Demo carries a safety veto, three critical atoms remain non-pass, and field value is unknown.

disagreements.issue: Whether the Web product is already highly usable

positions.position: Yes for responsive task execution on the frozen local candidate.
positions.evidence: Direct viewport, overflow, critical-target, recovery, source-authority, and final-smoke checks pass.

positions.position: Only the candidate is highly usable; the sellable product is not operationally usable because production cannot be entered.
positions.evidence: The live login exposes zero usable methods and real cross-day field use has not occurred.

disagreements.resolution: Call the frozen local Web candidate highly usable within the proven synthetic scope, but do not call the deployed system paid-ready or end-to-end production-usable.
disagreements.resolution_basis: Interaction quality, deployability, operational continuity, safety, and willingness to pay are distinct claims.

veto_resolution.veto: The deployed public Demo still converts unresolved relative time into confirmable deadline and meeting authority.

adjudication.rationale: The >99 and paid-release gates remain blocked. The frozen local build passes 94 of 100 atomic checks and directly completes almost the entire governed relationship loop. Production authenticated reachability fails; STATE-08 and ACTION-10 remain critical not_run; the live Demo retains an active safety veto; real-device assistive, field-value, and willingness-to-pay evidence are absent. Recruiter workflow is 3 of 4, safety is 2 of 4 with an active veto, and mobile UX is 3 of 4; these specialist scores are not averaged into 94.
